name: Tap Root
summary: A rooftop garden pipe puzzle: turn copper pipes until water reaches every seedling before the noon sun
about: A top-down kitchen garden on an Islamabad rooftop, with a brick-edged plot, a water tank with a spinning tap, copper pipes that spring round when you turn them and water that runs through them in a visible wave. Seedlings in clay pots bloom into mint, chili, tomato, marigold and more as soon as water reaches them, leaks drip at open pipe ends and the sun crosses an arc from dawn to noon. Eight plots are generated from fixed seeds so every one has a real solution and a par number of turns.
how: A demo plot plays on load; press Start the day, Let me try or click any tile to take over.
Click a pipe to turn it clockwise; right-click or Q turns it back. Arrow keys move between tiles and Enter turns.
Water flows from the tank through every joined pipe; get it to every seed packet's bed before the sun reaches noon.
Leaks drip where a pipe opens onto nothing. Finishing near par and with no leaks earns bonus points.
H turns one main pipe for you but moves the sun half an hour on; R replays the plot and P pauses the sun.
Finished plots and your best score are saved on this device, and reduced motion keeps the water still.
